ui:help.en: Off: nothing is checked. Observe: requests pass and are moderated in the background, results are recorded. Enforce: each request waits for the verdict and a block verdict refuses it. With base URL, API key or model empty the plugin behaves as off.
ui:help.zh: 关闭：不审核。观察：请求直接放行，后台异步审核并记录结果。拦截：每个请求等待审核结论，判为 block 时拒绝。接口地址、API Key、模型任一为空时视同关闭。

ui:help.en: OpenAI-compatible API root, e.g. https://api.openai.com or https://host/v1. A URL ending in /v1 gets /chat/completions appended, otherwise /v1/chat/completions. It may point at this gateway: the plugin recognises its own calls and does not moderate them again.
ui:help.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口地址，如 https://api.openai.com 或 https://host/v1。以 /v1 结尾时拼接 /chat/completions，否则拼接 /v1/chat/completions。可以指向本网关自身，插件自己的审核请求会被识别、不会再次审核。

ui:help.en: Sent as Authorization: Bearer.
ui:help.zh: 以 Authorization: Bearer 方式发送。

ui:help.en: Model that moderates the prompts; it should support tool calls (function calling) or answer in JSON.
ui:help.zh: 用于审核的模型，需要支持工具调用（function calling），或能直接输出 JSON 结论。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt. {{categories}} is replaced by the category list, one "- id: description" line each.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置提示词。{{categories}} 会替换为分类列表（每行一个"- id：说明"）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the 12 built-in categories. The LLM may only report these ids.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置的 12 个分类。模型只能从这些分类 id 中选择。

ui:help.en: Lower-case letters, digits and _ (1-32).
ui:help.zh: 小写字母、数字、下划线，1–32 位。

ui:placeholder.zh: 违法犯罪：毒品、武器、诈骗等

ui:help.en: How the LLM is asked to call submit_verdict. Use auto for upstreams that reject forced tool calls.
ui:help.zh: 要求模型调用 submit_verdict 的方式。上游不支持强制调用工具时选 auto。

ui:help.en: Agent loop rounds; the LLM is asked again when it calls no tool or passes invalid arguments.
ui:help.zh: 模型未调用工具或参数不合法时会被追问，这是包括首轮在内的最多轮数。

ui:help.en: Total time for one moderation, including all turns and waiting for a free slot.
ui:help.zh: 单次审核的总时限，包含所有轮次和排队等待。

ui:help.en: Enforce mode: what happens when moderation fails (timeout, upstream error, no verdict). Refusing returns 503 moderation_unavailable.
ui:help.zh: 拦截模式下审核失败（超时、上游错误、模型始终不给结论）时的处理。拒绝时返回 503 moderation_unavailable。

ui:help.en: Concurrent LLM calls on each node; also the number of observe workers.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点同时进行的审核调用数，也是观察模式的工作协程数。

ui:help.en: Observe mode: requests waiting for moderation on each node. When full, new ones are skipped and counted as dropped.
ui:help.zh: 观察模式下每个节点等待审核的请求数上限，满了之后新请求不再审核并计入丢弃数。

ui:help.en: Longer text keeps the first 2/3 and the last 1/3.
ui:help.zh: 超过时保留前 2/3 和后 1/3。

ui:help.en: Text shorter than this (ignoring whitespace) is not moderated.
ui:help.zh: 去掉空白后短于该字数的文本不审核。

ui:help.en: Share of requests moderated, chosen deterministically by text.
ui:help.zh: 按文本确定性抽样的审核比例。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests of these groups; empty means all groups.
ui:help.zh: 只审核这些分组的请求，留空表示全部分组。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests for matching client models (* and ? wildcards); empty means all.
ui:help.zh: 只审核匹配的客户端模型（支持 * 和 ? 通配），留空表示全部。

ui:help.en: Requests of these users are never moderated.
ui:help.zh: 这些用户的请求不审核。

ui:help.en: Verdicts of identical text are reused for this long (in memory and shared across nodes); changing the model, prompt, categories or tool choice starts over. 0 disables the cache.
ui:help.zh: 相同文本的审核结论缓存时长（内存 + 跨节点共享），修改模型、提示词、分类或工具调用方式后自动失效。0 表示不缓存。

ui:help.en: Error message returned to the client when a request is refused (code moderation_blocked).
ui:help.zh: 请求被拒绝时返回给客户端的错误信息（错误码 moderation_blocked）。

ui:help.en: Also store records for pass verdicts (flag, block and errors are always recorded).
ui:help.zh: 通过的审核也写入记录（flag、block 和错误始终记录）。

ui:help.en: Keep the (truncated) text in the records. It may contain user data.
ui:help.zh: 在审核记录中保存（截断后的）文本，可能包含用户数据。

ui:help.en: Ban a user automatically after this many block verdicts within the window (observe mode counts too). 0 disables automatic bans.
ui:help.zh: 窗口内 block 结论达到该次数时自动封禁用户（观察模式也计数），0 表示不自动封禁。

ui:help.en: 0 bans until an administrator unblocks the user.
ui:help.zh: 0 表示直到管理员手动解封。
